purpose: Training-free exploratory color/shape segmentation; no manual GT or deletion

parameters.color_space: OpenCV float32 BGR [0,1] to CIELab; L [0,100], signed a/b
parameters.local_color_background: quarter-size Lab, Gaussian sigma16, resized to native
parameters.red_growth: 8-connected weak-color components with at least 2 seed pixels; independent of gray foreground
parameters.component_paper_ring: bbox expanded16 pixels; exclude gray foreground and red candidates; median Lab
parameters.policy: dense brown-evidence blobs -> stain candidate; other dense blobs -> hold; no pixels deleted
parameters.scale_disagreement: only unprotected pixels with 1 or 2 votes; diagnostic hold, not calibrated uncertainty
parameters.border: no forced background; all classification at native resolution

modes.color_only: 原画像の色を追加：形の判定なし
modes.color_shape: 色＋詰まった塊の判定＋保留
